method_note: No image-viewing capability exists in this environment. No human aesthetic viewing was performed.
note: PRIMARY/SECONDARY are art-direction style references, not gameplay promotions. REJECT_AS_STYLE_REFERENCE candidates remain usable assets but must not teach future generators the project's visual language.
